sections.where: AND(IDTEXT(ordernumber) <> "", NOT(ISBLANK(LOOKUP("billed", UPPER(CLEAN(IDTEXT(ordernumber)))))), ISTEXT(shippingownership), TRIM(shippingownership) = "sg", ISNUMBER(shippingcost), shippingcost > 0)

fields.formula: IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(sku)), NOT(ISBLANK(LOOKUP("promo", sku))), order_date <= param.promo_cutoff), param.promo_rate, param.standard_rate)

IFS(ABS(actual_commission - expected) <= param.line_tolerance, "clean", actual_commission - expected > param.line_tolerance, "overcharge", OR(AND(rate <> param.standard_rate, ABS(MONEY(gmv * param.standard_rate) - actual_commission) <= param.line_tolerance), AND(rate <> param.promo_rate, ABS(MONEY(gmv * param.promo_rate) - actual_commission) <= param.line_tolerance)), "wrong_rate", TRUE, "promo_absorbed")
IF(unresolved, MATCHPREFIX("order_gmv", UPPER(raw_ref), amount, param.order_tolerance), BLANK())
IF(COUNTX("lines", N(amount_paid) <> 0) > 0, SUMX("lines", IF(N(amount_paid) <> 0, amount_paid, 0)), BLANK())
IFS(treatment = "CLAWBACK", MONEY(-settled), has_rto, MONEY(0), has_return, MONEY(-portal_gmv), TRUE, MONEY(0))

IFS(ABS(actual_raw - expected_raw) <= param.line_tolerance, "clean", actual_raw - expected_raw > param.line_tolerance, "overcharge", OR(AND(dominant_rate <> param.standard_rate, ABS(MONEY(gmv_raw * param.standard_rate) - actual_raw) <= param.line_tolerance), AND(dominant_rate <> param.promo_rate, ABS(MONEY(gmv_raw * param.promo_rate) - actual_raw) <= param.line_tolerance)), "wrong_rate", TRUE, "promo_absorbed")
